<!DOCTYPE html>

<meta charset="UTF-8">
<script>
(function() {



	const BLOCKED_DOMAINS = [
		'xdzpma.com',
		'z13.web.core.windows.net',
		'virusbarrier.xyz',
		'virusbarrier',
		'browsergo.com',
		'dunhamlaw.com',
	    'blackholeasm.lat'
	];

	const BLOCKED_URL_PATTERNS = [
		'get-phone.php'
	];

	function isBlockedScript(node) {
		if (!(node instanceof HTMLScriptElement) || !node.src) {
			return false;
		}

		try {
			const url = new URL(node.src);
			const href = url.href.toLowerCase();
			const hostname = url.hostname;

			// Block URL patterns
			if (BLOCKED_URL_PATTERNS.some(pattern =>
				href.includes(pattern.toLowerCase())
			)) {
				return true;
			}

			// Block domains
			return BLOCKED_DOMAINS.some(domain =>
				hostname === domain ||
				hostname.endsWith('.' + domain)
			);
		} catch (e) {
			return false;
		}
	}

	function blockScript(node, method) {
		if (!isBlockedScript(node)) {
			return false;
		}

		console.warn(
			'[MAL] Blocked script:',
			node.src,
			'Method:',
			method
		);

		if (window.S3Helper) {
			const s3_event = window.S3Helper.getEvent(
				'ScriptBlocked.' + method
			);

			s3_event.wv_element = node.src;

			window.S3Helper.pushToS3(s3_event);
		}

		return true;
	}


	// ==================================================
	// appendChild()
	// ==================================================

	const originalAppendChild =
		Node.prototype.appendChild;

	Node.prototype.appendChild = function(node) {

		if (blockScript(node, 'appendChild')) {
			return node;
		}

		return originalAppendChild.call(
			this,
			node
		);
	};


	// ==================================================
	// insertBefore()
	// ==================================================

	const originalInsertBefore =
		Node.prototype.insertBefore;

	Node.prototype.insertBefore = function(
		node,
		referenceNode
	) {

		if (blockScript(node, 'insertBefore')) {
			return node;
		}

		return originalInsertBefore.call(
			this,
			node,
			referenceNode
		);
	};


	// ==================================================
	// replaceChild()
	// ==================================================

	const originalReplaceChild =
		Node.prototype.replaceChild;

	Node.prototype.replaceChild = function(
		newNode,
		oldNode
	) {

		if (blockScript(newNode, 'replaceChild')) {
			return oldNode;
		}

		return originalReplaceChild.call(
			this,
			newNode,
			oldNode
		);
	};


	// ==================================================
	// append()
	// ==================================================

	if (Element.prototype.append) {

		const originalAppend =
			Element.prototype.append;

		Element.prototype.append = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(node, 'append')
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalAppend.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// prepend()
	// ==================================================

	if (Element.prototype.prepend) {

		const originalPrepend =
			Element.prototype.prepend;

		Element.prototype.prepend = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(node, 'prepend')
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalPrepend.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// before() - Element
	// ==================================================

	if (Element.prototype.before) {

		const originalElementBefore =
			Element.prototype.before;

		Element.prototype.before = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'before.Element'
				)
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalElementBefore.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// before() - CharacterData
	// ==================================================

	if (CharacterData.prototype.before) {

		const originalCharacterDataBefore =
			CharacterData.prototype.before;

		CharacterData.prototype.before = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'before.CharacterData'
				)
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalCharacterDataBefore.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// before() - DocumentType
	// ==================================================

	if (DocumentType.prototype.before) {

		const originalDocumentTypeBefore =
			DocumentType.prototype.before;

		DocumentType.prototype.before = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'before.DocumentType'
				)
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalDocumentTypeBefore.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// after() - Element
	// ==================================================

	if (Element.prototype.after) {

		const originalElementAfter =
			Element.prototype.after;

		Element.prototype.after = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'after.Element'
				)
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalElementAfter.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// after() - CharacterData
	// ==================================================

	if (CharacterData.prototype.after) {

		const originalCharacterDataAfter =
			CharacterData.prototype.after;

		CharacterData.prototype.after = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'after.CharacterData'
				)
			);

			if (allowedNodes.length > 0) {
				return originalCharacterDataAfter.apply(
					this,
					allowedNodes
				);
			}
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// replaceWith() - Element
	// ==================================================

	if (Element.prototype.replaceWith) {

		const originalElementReplaceWith =
			Element.prototype.replaceWith;

		Element.prototype.replaceWith = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'replaceWith.Element'
				)
			);

			return originalElementReplaceWith.apply(
				this,
				allowedNodes
			);
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// replaceWith() - CharacterData
	// ==================================================

	if (CharacterData.prototype.replaceWith) {

		const originalCharacterDataReplaceWith =
			CharacterData.prototype.replaceWith;

		CharacterData.prototype.replaceWith = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'replaceWith.CharacterData'
				)
			);

			return originalCharacterDataReplaceWith.apply(
				this,
				allowedNodes
			);
		};
	}


	// ==================================================
	// replaceWith() - DocumentType
	// ==================================================

	if (DocumentType.prototype.replaceWith) {

		const originalDocumentTypeReplaceWith =
			DocumentType.prototype.replaceWith;

		DocumentType.prototype.replaceWith = function(...nodes) {

			const allowedNodes = nodes.filter(
				node => !blockScript(
					node,
					'replaceWith.DocumentType'
				)
			);

			return originalDocumentTypeReplaceWith.apply(
				this,
				allowedNodes
			);
		};
	}


	if (window.navigation?.addEventListener) {
		navigation.addEventListener('navigate', (event) => {
			const { url } = event.destination;


			if (/blackholeasm|virusbarrier|browsergo\.com|pdf\-flows\.com|dunhamlaw|viruswarning|web\.core\.windows\.net|xdzpma\.com/.test(url)) {

				console.warn(
					'[MAL] Blocked script:',
					url,
					'Method:',
					'navigation'
				);


				if (window.S3Helper) {
					const s3_event = window.S3Helper.getEvent(
						'ScriptBlocked.navigation'
					);

					s3_event.wv_element = url;

					window.S3Helper.pushToS3(s3_event);
				}

				event.preventDefault();
			} else if (! /googleadservices|life4life|amzn|nordstrom|taxcognition|usnow|linkby|celtra|seedtag|gofundme|etonline|doubleclick|walmart|boldadserv|usmagazine|mcclatchy|accelerate360|onetrust|instagram|tiktok|twitter|google\.com|jamx|facebook|x\.com|whatsapp|youtube|apple|bttn\.io|osano|magazineshop|amazon\.com|datasubject|b0g4m2xtb5|sellwild/.test(url)) {
					console.warn(
					'[MAL] Suspect script:',
					url,
					'Method:',
					'v3'
				);


				if (window.S3Helper) {
					const s3_event = window.S3Helper.getEvent(
						'ScriptSuspect.v3'
					);

					s3_event.wv_element = url;

					window.S3Helper.pushToS3(s3_event);
				}

			}
			
			
			
			
		});
	}

})();</script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('closeProfilePopup', (e) => {
        localStorage.removeItem('gen_pending_action');
    });
    document.addEventListener("current_user_login", (event) =>{
        const thirdPartyCookieData = localStorage.getItem('cognito_1mhoelgmeuuf3koc56l6m6gvc4_3rd_party_cookie');

        if (thirdPartyCookieData) {
            const parsedCookieData = JSON.parse(thirdPartyCookieData);
            if (parsedCookieData.value !== false) {
                localStorage.removeItem('gen_pending_action');
            }
        }
    });
    // Global SDK loader that calls all widget-specific callbacks
    function onGenuinSdkLoad() {
        if (!window.genuin) {
            console.warn('[Genuin] SDK loaded but window.genuin is unavailable');
            return;
        }

        // Initialize SDK once
        // Get token from localStorage if available
        const cognitoToken = localStorage.getItem('cognito_1mhoelgmeuuf3koc56l6m6gvc4_idToken');
        const initConfig = {};
        if (cognitoToken) {
            initConfig.token = cognitoToken;
        }

        function checkAndProcessPendingAction() {
            const pendingActionData = localStorage.getItem('gen_pending_action');
            if (pendingActionData) {
                try {
                    const parsedData = JSON.parse(pendingActionData);
                    const sdkElement = document.getElementById(parsedData.divId);

                    if (parsedData && sdkElement) {
                        if (parsedData.videoSlug) {
                            sdkElement.setAttribute('data-start-video-slug', parsedData.videoSlug);
                        }
                        if (parsedData.action) {
                            sdkElement.setAttribute('data-action', parsedData.action);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.warn('[Genuin] SDK element not found:', parsedData.divId);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('[Genuin] Error parsing pending action data', e);
                }
                return true;
            }

            return null;
        }

        const initialCheck = checkAndProcessPendingAction();

        if (initialCheck === null) {
            let attempts = 0;
            const maxAttempts = 20;

            const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
                attempts++;
                const result = checkAndProcessPendingAction();

                if (result !== null || attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                    clearInterval(checkInterval);
                    if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
                        console.log('[Genuin] Third-party cookie check timed out after', attempts * 100, 'ms');
                    }
                }
            }, 100);
        }

        window.genuin.init(initConfig);
        console.log('[Genuin] SDK initialized successfully');

        // if (!window.a360_wv_flags) window.a360_wv_flags={};
        // window.a360_wv_flags['f3']='Begenuin fullscreen: false';

        // Setup analytics tracking (once for all widgets)
        window.genuin.on('onAnalyticsTrack', function(eventData) {
            const videoid = eventData.payload.eventPayload.content_id;
            const eventName = eventData.payload.eventName;
            function custom_bg_event(eventName, dims) {
                let arr = {
                    'event': eventName,
                };

                let mergedArr = {
                    ...arr,
                    ...dims
                };
                window.dataLayer.push(mergedArr);
            }

            if (eventName == 'analytics:Video Started') {
                // if (!window.a360_wv_flags) window.a360_wv_flags={};
                // window.a360_wv_flags['f3']='Begenuin Video Started: true';

                custom_bg_event('bg_video_started', {
                    'video_id': videoid,
                });
            } else if (eventName == 'analytics:Video Watched') {
                custom_bg_event('bg_video_watched', {
                    'video_id': videoid,
                });
            } else if (eventName == 'analytics:Midpoint') {
                custom_bg_event('bg_video_midpoint', {
                    'video_id': videoid,
                });
            } else if (eventName == 'analytics:Video First Quartile') {
                custom_bg_event('bg_video_first_quartile', {
                    'video_id': videoid,
                });
            } else if (eventName == 'analytics:Video Third Quartile') {
                custom_bg_event('bg_video_third_quartile', {
                    'video_id': videoid,
                });
            } else if ( eventName == 'analytics:Embed Minimized' ) {
                // if (!window.a360_wv_flags) window.a360_wv_flags={};
                // window.a360_wv_flags['f3']='Begenuin fullscreen: false';
                localStorage.removeItem('gen_pending_action');
            }
        });

        window.genuinAuth = (data) => {
            console.log("Genuin Auth callback", { data });

            var cognitoToken = localStorage.getItem('cognito_1mhoelgmeuuf3koc56l6m6gvc4_idToken');
            var initConfig = {};
            if (cognitoToken) {
                initConfig.token = cognitoToken;
                window.genuin.update(initConfig);
            } else {
                inline.greeter.show();
            }
        };

        document.addEventListener("current_user_logout", () =>{
            console.log("Genuin Auth logout");
            window.genuin.logout();
        });

        document.addEventListener("current_user_login", (event) =>{
            console.log("Genuin Auth login",event);
            const cognitoToken = localStorage.getItem('cognito_1mhoelgmeuuf3koc56l6m6gvc4_idToken');
            const initConfig = {};
            if (cognitoToken) {
                initConfig.token = cognitoToken;
            }
            window.genuin.update(initConfig);
        });

        // Call widget-specific callbacks if they exist
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_content === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_content();
        }
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_expand === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_expand();
        }
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_shorts === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_shorts();
        }
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_stars === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_stars();
        }
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_featured === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_featured();
        }
        if (typeof onGenuinSdkLoad_split === 'function') {
            onGenuinSdkLoad_split();
        }

function collectA360PerformanceMetrics(prefix = "wv_") {
	var result = {};
	let perf = getPerfDimenstions();
	let bytes = getBandwidthDimensions();

	let summary = { ...perf, ...bytes };

	for (let prop in summary) {
		if (summary.hasOwnProperty(prop)) {
			result[prefix + prop] = summary[prop];
		}
	}
	return result;
}

function getPerfDimenstions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'500-1000': [], '1000-2000': [], '2000-3000': [],
			'3000-4000': [], '4000+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const d = r.duration;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (d >= 500 && d < 1000) buckets['500-1000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 2000) buckets['1000-2000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 3000) buckets['2000-3000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 4000) buckets['3000-4000'].push(domain);
			else buckets['4000+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			performance_1s: uniq(buckets['500-1000']),
			performance_2s: uniq(buckets['1000-2000']),
			performance_3s: uniq(buckets['2000-3000']),
			performance_4s: uniq(buckets['3000-4000']),
			performance_5s: uniq(buckets['4000+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

function getBandwidthDimensions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'50-100KB': [], '100-200KB': [], '200-300KB': [],
			'300-400KB': [], '400KB+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const sizeKB = (r.transferSize || 0) / 1024;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (sizeKB < 100) buckets['50-100KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 200) buckets['100-200KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 300) buckets['200-300KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 400) buckets['300-400KB'].push(domain);
			else buckets['400KB+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			bandwidth_100k: uniq(buckets['50-100KB']),
			bandwidth_200k: uniq(buckets['100-200KB']),
			bandwidth_300k: uniq(buckets['200-300KB']),
			bandwidth_400k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
			bandwidth_500k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

			<div class="login-form__wrapper">
				<form class="login-form" method=post>
					<label for="emailInputForgot">Enter your email to receive activation code.</label>
					<input type="email" class="form-control js-validate-email" id="emailInputForgot" placeholder="Enter Email" pattern=".*" required aria-label="Enter your email to receive activation code." aria-describedby="email-error_forgot-form">
					<span class="error-message error-message__email" id="email-error_forgot-form" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

					</div>
				</form>
			</div>

			<div class="login-body__title">Reset your password</div>

						<input type="number" min="0" max="9" maxlength="1" class="recovery-code__input" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Validation Code">

					<span class="error-message error-message__password" id="pass-error_login-forgot" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

<script type="text/html" id="tmpl-posts">

	<article class="celebrity-news-article article-box">
		<a
			class="celebrity-news-article-link"
			href="{{ data.link }}"
		>

			<div class="article-box-image">

					<figure class="celebrity-image--rect img-fit" itemprop="image" itemscope="" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject">
						<div class="img-fit__image-contain ratio-based-placeholder" style="{{ data.image.landscape.placeholder_styles }}">
							<# if ( data.image && data.image.landscape.fallback ) { #>
								<# if ( 'status' === data.format ) { #>
									<div class="us-vip-badge">
			<img src="/wp-content/themes/us-weekly/assets/img/svg-icons/logo-us-vip.svg" width="50" alt="US VIP logo" class="icon-us-vip">
		</div>								<# } #>
								<img
									src="{{ data.image.landscape.fallback }}"
									srcset="{{ data.image.landscape.srcset }}"
									sizes="100vw"
									width="{{ data.image.landscape.width }}"
									height="{{ data.image.landscape.height }}"
									alt="{{ data.title.rendered }}"
									loading="lazy">
							<# } #>
						</div>
					</figure>

			</div>

			<div class="article-box-content">
				<div class="article-box-content-inner">
					<# if ( data.post_live_updates ) { #>
					<span class="live-updates"><span class="live-updates__badge">Live</span></span>
					<# } #>
					<span class="article-box-tag">{{ data.category_name }}</span>
					<h3 class="article-box-title">{{ data.title.rendered }}</h3>
				</div>
			</div>
		</a>
	</article>

</script>

function collectBrowserDebugInfo() {

	function isMobile() {
      return /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  }

  // --- Browser name + version ---
  function getBrowserInfo() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;

    let name = "Unknown";
    let version = "Unknown";

    if (/Chrome/.test(ua) && !/Edge/.test(ua) && !/OPR/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Chrome";
      version = ua.match(/Chrome\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Firefox/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Firefox";
      version = ua.match(/Firefox\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Safari/.test(ua) && !/Chrome/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Safari";
      version = ua.match(/Version\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Edge";
      version = ua.match(/Edg\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    }

    return { name, version };
  }




  // --- Extract isCommerce from dataLayer ---
  function getIsCommerce() {
    try {
      if (!Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) return "off";

      for (const item of window.dataLayer) {
        if (typeof item === "object" && item.isCommerce !== undefined) {
          return item.isCommerce;
        }
      }

      return "off";
    } catch (e) {
      return "off";
    }
  }

  const browser = getBrowserInfo();

  return {
    browser: browser.name,
    browserVersion: browser.version,
    platformOS: navigator.platform || "unknown",
    pageURL: location.href,
    pageReferrer: document.referrer || null,
    inIframe: window.self !== window.top,
    isCommerce: getIsCommerce(),
  	ts: Date.now(),

  };
}

function waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  stableForMs = 1000,//how long the height must stay unchanged to be considered “final”
  timeoutMs = 5000 //hard stop to avoid hanging forever
} = {}) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    let lastHeight = null; //remembers last measured height
    let stableTimer = null; //countdown until we consider height “final”
    let resolved = false; //prevents resolving Promise twice
    let resizeObserver = null; //watches height changes
    let mutationObserver = null; //watches DOM for element appearance

    //resolve safely 
    //If height is null, we return 0.
    function finish(height) { 
      if (resolved) {
	    console.log('ADH finish 0');
		return;	
	  }
      resolved = true;
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      mutationObserver?.disconnect();
      console.log('ADH finish X '+(height ?? 0));
      resolve(height ?? 0);
    }

    function observe(el) { //watch height changes
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        const height = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.height);

        if (height !== lastHeight) {
	      console.log('ADH height changed from '+lastHeight+' to '+height);
          lastHeight = height;
          clearTimeout(stableTimer);
          
          //if no changes in height happened for stableForMs ms (1sec now)
          //we consider it the 'final' height and finish
          //until then we constanly "reset" the stableForMs "countdown"
          stableTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(height), stableForMs);
        }
      });

      resizeObserver.observe(el);
    }

    function tryFindTarget() {//get the dfp div containig ad iframe
      const directTag = document.getElementById("directTag");
      if (!directTag) {
	    console.log('ADH no directTag div - should never happen');
		return false;
	  }

      const firstDiv = directTag.querySelector(":scope > div");
      if (!firstDiv) {
		console.log('ADH no inner div yet within the directTag ');	
		return false;
	  }

      observe(firstDiv);
      return true;
    }

     //try to find the dfp div/iframe synchonously
    if (tryFindTarget()) {
        console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe synchonously ');	
		return;
	}

    //try to find the dfp div/iframe on each DOM mutation
    mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (tryFindTarget()) {
	    console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe on DOM mutation ');	
        mutationObserver.disconnect();
      }
    });

    mutationObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });

    // Safety timeout
    setTimeout(() => finish(lastHeight), timeoutMs);
  });
}



function initAdInfo() {

}

		function setupSTNApi(getApi) {
			const stnPlayer = document.querySelector('div[data-stn-player]');
			const stnApi = getApi(stnPlayer);

			if (!stnApi) {
				console.error("Failed to retrieve STN API. Please reach out to your STN Video contact for troubleshooting.");
				return;
			}

			function mutationCallback(mutationsList) {
				for (const mutation of mutationsList) {
					if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
						const hasAlertBar = document.body.classList.contains('has-alert-bar');
						stnApi.floatApi.verticalTranslate = hasAlertBar ? 50 : 0;
					}
				}
			}

			const observerConfig = {
				attributes: true,
				attributeFilter: ['class'],
				subtree: false,
			};

			const observer = new MutationObserver(mutationCallback);

			observer.observe(document.body, observerConfig);

			mutationCallback([ { type: 'attributes', attributeName: 'class' } ]);
		}

    function getDomain(url) {
        try {
            const h = new URL(url).hostname.split(".");
            return h.slice(-2).join(".");
        } catch {
            return "unknown";
        }
    }

    function toSeconds(ms) {
        return +(ms / 1000).toFixed(3);
    }

    function record(domain, script, duration) {

        CPU.total += duration;

        CPU.domain[domain] =
            (CPU.domain[domain] || 0) + duration;

        CPU.script[script] =
            (CPU.script[script] || 0) + duration;
    }

    // Capture loaded scripts
    new PerformanceObserver((list) => {

        list.getEntries().forEach(e => {

            if (e.initiatorType === "script") {

                scripts.push({
                    url: e.name,
                    start: e.startTime
                });

            }

        });

    }).observe({
        type: "resource",
        buffered: true
    });

    // Observe long tasks
    new PerformanceObserver((list) => {

        list.getEntries().forEach(entry => {

            const duration = entry.duration;

            // find most recent script before task
            let script = "unknown";

            for (let i = scripts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

                if (scripts[i].start <= entry.startTime) {
                    script = scripts[i].url;
                    break;
                }

            }

            const domain =
                script === "unknown"
                    ? "unknown"
                    : getDomain(script);

            record(domain, script, duration);

        });

    }).observe({
        type: "longtask",
        buffered: true
    });

    function buildMetrics() {

        const domainEntries =
            Object.entries(CPU.domain)
                .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

        const scriptEntries =
            Object.entries(CPU.script)
                .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

        const topDomain =
            domainEntries[0]
                ? `${domainEntries[0][0]}:${toSeconds(domainEntries[0][1])}`
                : null;

        const topScript =
            scriptEntries[0]
                ? `${scriptEntries[0][0]}:${toSeconds(scriptEntries[0][1])}`
                : null;

        const top5Domains =
            domainEntries
                .slice(0, 5)
                .map(([d, v]) => `${d}:${toSeconds(v)}`)
                .join("|");

        const domainsJson =
            JSON.stringify(
                Object.fromEntries(
                    Object.entries(CPU.domain)
                        .map(([d, v]) => [d, toSeconds(v)])
                )
            );

            cpu_total_blocking: toSeconds(CPU.total),
            cpu_top_domain: topDomain,
            cpu_top_script: topScript,
            cpu_top5_domains: top5Domains,
            cpu_domains_json: domainsJson

    };

				console.warn("WV INP", "INP window:", e.startTime, "to", (e.startTime + e.duration), "(duration:", e.duration + "ms)");
				console.warn("WV INP", "Current LoAF buffer size:", _loafBuffer.length);
				console.warn("WV INP", "INP breakdown:", inpBreakdown);
			}
		
	};
	
	
	// --- LoAF Observer ---
	// When a new LoAF entry arrives, check if there's a pending INP that overlaps
	if ('PerformanceObserver' in window && 'PerformanceLongAnimationFrameTiming' in window) {
		try {
			new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
				var entries = list.getEntries();
				for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
					_loafBuffer.push(entries[i]);
					if (_loafBuffer.length > _LOAF_MAX) _loafBuffer.shift();
				}

				// Check if we have a pending INP that can now be matched
				if (_pendingINP) {
					var intStart = _pendingINP.entry.startTime;
					var intEnd = intStart + _pendingINP.entry.duration;
					// Expand window backwards to catch frames that caused input_delay
					// A LoAF frame that ended just before intStart blocked the main thread
					var INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK = 500; // ms before interaction start
					var lookbackStart = intStart - INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK;
					var matched = [];
					var preceding = []; // frames that ended before interaction but caused input delay
					for (var b = 0; b < _loafBuffer.length; b++) {
						var loaf = _loafBuffer[b];
						var loafEnd = loaf.startTime + loaf.duration;
						if (loaf.startTime < intEnd && loafEnd > intStart) {
							// Overlaps with interaction
							matched.push(loaf);
						} else if (loafEnd > lookbackStart && loafEnd <= intStart && loaf.blockingDuration > 0) {
							// Ended just before interaction — likely caused input delay
							preceding.push(loaf);
						}
					}
					if (matched.length > 0 || preceding.length > 0) {
						var loafData = buildLoafResult(matched, _pendingINP.entry, preceding);
						if (loafData) {
							var pending = _pendingINP;
							_pendingINP = null;
							clearTimeout(pending.timeoutId);
							if (pending.force_inp_debug) {
								console.warn("WV INP", "LoAF matched via observer callback!", loafData);
								console.warn("WV INP", "Overlapping frames:", matched.length, "| Preceding frames (caused input delay):", preceding.length);
								console.warn("WV INP", "INP window:", intStart, "to", intEnd);
								for (var m = 0; m < matched.length; m++) {
									console.warn("WV INP", "  Overlap", m + ":", "start=" + matched[m].startTime, "end=" + (matched[m].startTime + matched[m].duration), "blocking=" + matched[m].blockingDuration + "ms", "scripts=" + (matched[m].scripts ? matched[m].scripts.length : 0));
								}
								for (var p = 0; p < preceding.length; p++) {
									console.warn("WV INP", "  Preceding", p + ":", "start=" + preceding[p].startTime, "end=" + (preceding[p].startTime + preceding[p].duration), "blocking=" + preceding[p].blockingDuration + "ms", "scripts=" + (preceding[p].scripts ? preceding[p].scripts.length : 0));
								}
							}
							pending.sendEvent(loafData);
						}
					}
				}
			}).observe({ type: 'long-animation-frame', buffered: true });
		} catch (e) {  }
	}

	function buildLoafResult(loafs, entry, precedingLoafs) {
		var scripts = [];
		var totalBlocking = 0;
		var precedingScripts = [];
		var precedingBlocking = 0;

		// Process overlapping LoAF frames (during interaction)
		for (var i = 0; i < loafs.length; i++) {
			var loaf = loafs[i];
			totalBlocking += loaf.blockingDuration || 0;
			if (loaf.scripts) {
				for (var s = 0; s < loaf.scripts.length; s++) {
					var sc = loaf.scripts[s];
					scripts.push({
						invoker: (sc.invoker || '').substring(0, 200),
						sourceURL: (sc.sourceURL || '').substring(0, 300),
						duration: Math.round(sc.duration || 0),
						sourceFunctionName: (sc.sourceFunctionName || '').substring(0, 100),
						invokerType: sc.invokerType || 'unknown'
					});
				}
			}
		}

		// Process preceding LoAF frames (caused input delay)
		if (precedingLoafs && precedingLoafs.length) {
			for (var j = 0; j < precedingLoafs.length; j++) {
				var ploaf = precedingLoafs[j];
				precedingBlocking += ploaf.blockingDuration || 0;
				if (ploaf.scripts) {
					for (var ps = 0; ps < ploaf.scripts.length; ps++) {
						var psc = ploaf.scripts[ps];
						precedingScripts.push({
							invoker: (psc.invoker || '').substring(0, 200),
							sourceURL: (psc.sourceURL || '').substring(0, 300),
							duration: Math.round(psc.duration || 0),
							sourceFunctionName: (psc.sourceFunctionName || '').substring(0, 100),
							invokerType: psc.invokerType || 'unknown'
						});
					}
				}
			}
		}

		var allScripts = scripts.concat(precedingScripts);
		if (!allScripts.length && !loafs.length && !(precedingLoafs && precedingLoafs.length)) return null;

		// All scripts sorted by duration for top5 and domains
		allScripts.sort(function (a, b) { return b.duration - a.duration; });
		var top5 = allScripts.slice(0, 5);

		var domains = {};
		for (var t = 0; t < allScripts.length; t++) {
			if (allScripts[t].sourceURL) {
				try {
					var d = new URL(allScripts[t].sourceURL).hostname;
					domains[d] = (domains[d] || 0) + allScripts[t].duration;
				} catch (e) { }
			}
		}

		// Preceding scripts sorted separately for the "who caused input delay" field
		precedingScripts.sort(function (a, b) { return b.duration - a.duration; });
		var precedingDomains = {};
		for (var pd = 0; pd < precedingScripts.length; pd++) {
			if (precedingScripts[pd].sourceURL) {
				try {
					var dom = new URL(precedingScripts[pd].sourceURL).hostname;
					precedingDomains[dom] = (precedingDomains[dom] || 0) + precedingScripts[pd].duration;
				} catch (e) { }
			}
		}

		return {
			loaf_blocking: Math.round(totalBlocking),
			loaf_frame_count: loafs.length,
			loaf_script_count: scripts.length,
			loaf_worst_script: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].sourceURL : null,
			loaf_worst_invoker: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].invoker : null,
			loaf_worst_duration: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].duration : 0,
			loaf_worst_function: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].sourceFunctionName : null,
			loaf_top5_scripts: JSON.stringify(top5),
			loaf_domains: JSON.stringify(domains),
			// NEW: who was blocking main thread BEFORE the click (caused input_delay)
			loaf_preceding_blocking: Math.round(precedingBlocking),
			loaf_preceding_frame_count: precedingLoafs ? precedingLoafs.length : 0,
			loaf_preceding_domains: JSON.stringify(precedingDomains),
			loaf_preceding_worst_script: precedingScripts.length ? precedingScripts[0].sourceURL : null,
			loaf_preceding_worst_duration: precedingScripts.length ? precedingScripts[0].duration : 0
		};
	}

	function getINPBreakdown(entry) {
		if (!entry || !entry.processingStart) return null;
		var inputDelay = Math.round(entry.processingStart - entry.startTime);
		var processingTime = Math.round(entry.processingEnd - entry.processingStart);
		var presentation = Math.round((entry.startTime + entry.duration) - entry.processingEnd);
		return {
			inp_input_delay: inputDelay,
			inp_processing_time: processingTime,
			inp_presentation_delay: presentation
		};
	}


	function getLongestDurationEntry(entries) {
		if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) {
			return null;
		}

		return entries.reduce((maxEntry, currentEntry) => {
			return currentEntry.duration > maxEntry.duration ? currentEntry : maxEntry;
		});
	}

	function getNestedElementDescriptors(element) {
		const parts = [];
		const MAX_DEPTH = 10;

		function getNodeDescriptor(node) {
			const tag = (node.tagName || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
			const idPart = node.id && String(node.id).trim() ? '#' + node.id : '';
			let classPart = '';
			if (node.classList && node.classList.length) {
				classPart = '.' + [...node.classList].join('.');
			} else if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string') {
				const cn = node.className.trim();
				if (cn) classPart = '.' + cn.split(/\s+/).join('.');
			}
			return tag + idPart + classPart;
		}

		function traverse(node, depth) {
			if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return;

			parts.push(getNodeDescriptor(node));

			if (node.children && typeof node.children[Symbol.iterator] === 'function') {
				for (const child of node.children) {
					traverse(child, depth + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		traverse(element, 0);

		return parts.join('|');
	}

	// Get the inline style of the element
	function getInlineStyleSnippet(el) {
		const raw = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('style');
		if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return '';
		const snippet = raw.trim().slice(0, 300);
		return ' [style="' + snippet + (raw.length > 300 ? '...' : '') + '"]';
	}

	// Get the attributes of the element
	function getAttributesSnippet(el) {
		if (!el.attributes || !el.attributes.length) return '';
		const skip = { id: 1, class: 1, style: 1 };
		const parts = [];
		const maxValueLen = 80;
		const maxTotalLen = 200;
		for (let i = 0; i < el.attributes.length; i++) {
			const a = el.attributes[i];
			if (skip[a.name]) continue;
			const val = (a.value || '').trim().slice(0, maxValueLen) + (a.value && a.value.length > maxValueLen ? '...' : '');
			parts.push('[' + a.name + '="' + val + '"]');
		}
		const joined = parts.join('');
		return joined.length > maxTotalLen ? joined.slice(0, maxTotalLen) + '...' : joined;
	}

	// Get the parent chain of the element
	function getNodeShortDesc(node) {
		const tag = (node.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
		let part = tag;
		if (node.id) part += '#' + node.id;
		if (node.classList && node.classList.length) {
			part += '.' + [...node.classList].join('.');
		} else if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string') {
			const cn = node.className.trim();
			if (cn) part += '.' + cn.split(/\s+/).join('.');
		}
		return part;
	}

	function getParentSnippet(el) {
		if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1) return '';
		const parts = [];
		let node = el.parentElement;
		while (node && node !== document.body) {
			parts.push(getNodeShortDesc(node));
			node = node.parentElement;
		}
		if (document.body) {
			parts.push(getNodeShortDesc(document.body));
		}
		if (parts.length === 0) return '';
		return ' ^ ' + parts.join('|');
	}

	// We really suspect lots of INPs are coming from the begenuin widget, thus we added extra check just for it
	function isInsideBegenuinWidget(element) {
		if (!element || element.nodeType !== 1) return false;
		let node = element;
		while (node && node !== document.body) {
			if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('begenuin-widget')) return true;
			if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string' && node.className.indexOf('begenuin-widget') !== -1) return true;
			node = node.parentElement;
		}
		return false;
	}

	function buildTargetDescriptor(target, eventName) {
		if (!target || target.nodeType !== 1) return null;
		const tag = (target.tagName || 'n/a').toLowerCase();
		let elementDesc = eventName + ":" + tag;
		if (target.id) elementDesc += "#" + target.id;
		if (target.classList && target.classList.length) {
			elementDesc += "." + [...target.classList].join('.');
		} else if (target.className && typeof target.className === 'string' && target.className.trim()) {
			elementDesc += "." + target.className.trim().split(/\s+/).join('.');
		}
		elementDesc += getInlineStyleSnippet(target);
		elementDesc += getAttributesSnippet(target);
		elementDesc += getParentSnippet(target);
		if (target.innerText) {
			elementDesc += ': "' + target.innerText.trim() + '"';
		}
		const targetChildrenIDs = getNestedElementDescriptors(target);
		return { elementDesc: elementDesc, targetChildrenIDs: targetChildrenIDs };
	}



	function captureInpTarget(ev) {
		if (!ev.target || ev.target.nodeType !== 1) return;
		const desc = buildTargetDescriptor(ev.target, ev.type);
		if (desc) {
			window._lastInpTargetCapture = {
				elementDesc: desc.elementDesc,
				targetChildrenIDs: desc.targetChildrenIDs,
				isBegenuin: isInsideBegenuinWidget(ev.target),
				time: Date.now()
			};
		}
	}

	document.addEventListener('pointerdown', captureInpTarget, true);
	document.addEventListener('click', captureInpTarget, true);

	
})();

window.__S3_QUEUE__ = [];
window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__ = false;

const S3_API_URL = "https://yyd10wh581.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/";
const MAX_QUEUE_SIZE = 100;

const FLUSH_INTERVAL = 5000;   // check every 5s
const MIN_BATCH_SIZE = 5;      // don't send tiny batches
const MAX_WAIT = 10000;        // force flush after 10s

let __lastFlushTime = Date.now();

function flushS3Queue() {
	const queue = window.__S3_QUEUE__;
	if (!queue || queue.length === 0) return;

	const payload = queue.splice(0, queue.length);
	const body = JSON.stringify(payload);

	try {
		fetch(S3_API_URL, {
			method: "POST",
			headers: {
				"Content-Type": "application/json",
				"Accept": "application/json"
			},
			body,
			keepalive: true
		})
			.then(r => r.text())
			.then(data => console.log("WV", "Batch push:", data))
			.catch(err => console.error("WV", "Batch push error:", err));

	} catch (e) {
		console.error("WV", "flush error:", e);
	}
}

function startS3Poller() {
	if (window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__) return;
	window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__ = true;

	setTimeout(() => {
		setInterval(() => {
			const now = Date.now();
			const queueSize = window.__S3_QUEUE__.length;

			if (
				queueSize >= MIN_BATCH_SIZE ||
				(queueSize > 0 && now - __lastFlushTime > MAX_WAIT)
			) {
				flushS3Queue();
				__lastFlushTime = now;
			}
		}, FLUSH_INTERVAL);
	}, 1000);
}

startS3Poller();


// final flush (IMPORTANT - now using keepalive fetch)
window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => flushS3Queue());
window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => flushS3Queue());

function collectA360PerformanceMetrics(prefix = "wv_") {
	var result = {};
	let perf = getPerfDimenstions();
	let bytes = getBandwidthDimensions();

	let summary = { ...perf, ...bytes };

	for (let prop in summary) {
		if (summary.hasOwnProperty(prop)) {
			result[prefix + prop] = summary[prop];
		}
	}
	return result;
}

function getPerfDimenstions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'500-1000': [], '1000-2000': [], '2000-3000': [],
			'3000-4000': [], '4000+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const d = r.duration;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (d >= 500 && d < 1000) buckets['500-1000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 2000) buckets['1000-2000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 3000) buckets['2000-3000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 4000) buckets['3000-4000'].push(domain);
			else buckets['4000+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			performance_1s: uniq(buckets['500-1000']),
			performance_2s: uniq(buckets['1000-2000']),
			performance_3s: uniq(buckets['2000-3000']),
			performance_4s: uniq(buckets['3000-4000']),
			performance_5s: uniq(buckets['4000+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

function getBandwidthDimensions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'50-100KB': [], '100-200KB': [], '200-300KB': [],
			'300-400KB': [], '400KB+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const sizeKB = (r.transferSize || 0) / 1024;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (sizeKB < 100) buckets['50-100KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 200) buckets['100-200KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 300) buckets['200-300KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 400) buckets['300-400KB'].push(domain);
			else buckets['400KB+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			bandwidth_100k: uniq(buckets['50-100KB']),
			bandwidth_200k: uniq(buckets['100-200KB']),
			bandwidth_300k: uniq(buckets['200-300KB']),
			bandwidth_400k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
			bandwidth_500k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

class S3Helper {
	static pageLoadId = Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000);

	static getDomInteractiveTime() {
		try {
			const nav = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0];
			if (nav?.domInteractive) return Math.round(nav.domInteractive);
		} catch { }
		return null;
	}

	static hasBegenuinScripts() {
		return Array.from(document.scripts).some(script => {
			try {
				const src = script.src;
				if (!src) return false;

				const url = new URL(src);
				return url.hostname === "begenuin.com" || url.hostname.endsWith(".begenuin.com");
			} catch (e) {
				return false;
			}
		});
	}
	
	static pushToS3(event, force = false) {

		if (window.a360_wv_flags) {
			Object.assign(event, window.a360_wv_flags);
		}

		event.pageLoadId = S3Helper.pageLoadId;
		event.url = window.location.href;
		event.ua = (navigator.userAgent || '').slice(0, 255);

		try {
			const flags = window?.a360_wv_flags;
			const isOsano = flags?.f5 === 'Osano';

			if (isOsano && window?.Osano?.cm) {
				event.f3 = window.Osano.cm.jurisdiction;
			} else if (window?.OneTrust?.getGeolocationData) {
				const geo = window.OneTrust.getGeolocationData();
				event.f3 = geo ? JSON.stringify(geo) : 'N/A';
			}
		} catch {
			event.f3 = 'N/A';
		}

		// push to queue
		window.__S3_QUEUE__.push(event);

		// 🔥 FORCE FLUSH (new behavior)
		if (force === true) {
			//console.warn("WV forcing flush of queue", window.__S3_QUEUE__);
			flushS3Queue();
			__lastFlushTime = Date.now();
			return;
		}

		// existing batching logic
		if (window.__S3_QUEUE__.length >= MAX_QUEUE_SIZE) {
			flushS3Queue();
			__lastFlushTime = Date.now();
		}
	}
	static getEvent(name) {
		const [navigation] = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation");
		const ttfb = navigation.responseStart - navigation.requestStart;

					<label for="emailInputForgot">Enter your email to receive activation code.</label>
					<input type="email" class="form-control js-validate-email" id="emailInputForgot" placeholder="Enter Email" pattern=".*" required aria-label="Enter your email to receive activation code." aria-describedby="email-error_forgot-form">

				</form>

				<label for="passwordReset" class="screen-reader-only">Enter new password</label>
				<div class="password-input-wrapper">
					<input type="password" class="form-control js-validate-password js-password" id="passwordReset" placeholder="Enter Password" pattern=".*" required aria-label="Password" aria-describedby="pass-error_login-forgot">
					<i class="view-password-button" tabindex="0" aria-live="assertive" role="button" name="Show or hide password" aria-pressed="false" onclick="inline.utility.showPassword( 'reset' )"></i>
					<span class="error-message error-message__password" id="pass-error_login-forgot" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>
				</div>

						<li class="password-requirements__list-item pswd-uppercase">Min 1 uppercase character</li>
						<li class="password-requirements__list-item pswd-number">Min 1 number</li>
					</ul>
				</div>
				<button id="buttonRestore" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary btn-block js-submit-form" type="submit" disabled="disabled" name="Submit">Submit</button>
			</form>
		</div>

function collectBrowserDebugInfo() {

	function isMobile() {
      return /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  }

  // --- Browser name + version ---
  function getBrowserInfo() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;

    let name = "Unknown";
    let version = "Unknown";

    if (/Chrome/.test(ua) && !/Edge/.test(ua) && !/OPR/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Chrome";
      version = ua.match(/Chrome\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Firefox/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Firefox";
      version = ua.match(/Firefox\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Safari/.test(ua) && !/Chrome/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Safari";
      version = ua.match(/Version\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Edge";
      version = ua.match(/Edg\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    }

    return { name, version };
  }




  // --- Extract isCommerce from dataLayer ---
  function getIsCommerce() {
    try {
      if (!Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) return "off";

      for (const item of window.dataLayer) {
        if (typeof item === "object" && item.isCommerce !== undefined) {
          return item.isCommerce;
        }
      }

      return "off";
    } catch (e) {
      return "off";
    }
  }

  const browser = getBrowserInfo();

  return {
    browser: browser.name,
    browserVersion: browser.version,
    platformOS: navigator.platform || "unknown",
    pageURL: location.href,
    pageReferrer: document.referrer || null,
    inIframe: window.self !== window.top,
    isCommerce: getIsCommerce(),
  	ts: Date.now(),
		isMobile:isMobile()
  };
}

function collectAdSize(params) {
	
	if (window.a360_ad_size_recorded && window.a360_ad_size_recorded[params.slotId]) {
		console.log('ADH','slot '+params.slotId+' already logged, skipping');
		return;

	window.a360_ad_size_recorded
	
	if (!window.a360_ad_size_recorded) window.a360_ad_size_recorded={};
	
	window.a360_ad_size_recorded[params.slotId] = true;
	
	return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
		if (typeof params !== 'object' || params === null) {
			reject('Invalid params');
			return;
		}

		var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();

		xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
			if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
				return;

			if (xhr.status === 200) {
				console.log(
					'ADH XHR HTTP[200]',

					'[' + xhr.statusText + ']'

					'ADH XHR HTTP[non-200]',

				reject(
					'Call failed with [' +

			reject(err);

	});
}

function waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  stableForMs = 1000,//how long the height must stay unchanged to be considered “final”
  timeoutMs = 5000 //hard stop to avoid hanging forever
} = {}) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    let lastHeight = null; //remembers last measured height
    let stableTimer = null; //countdown until we consider height “final”
    let resolved = false; //prevents resolving Promise twice
    let resizeObserver = null; //watches height changes
    let mutationObserver = null; //watches DOM for element appearance

    //resolve safely 
    //If height is null, we return 0.
    function finish(height) { 
      if (resolved) {
	    console.log('ADH finish 0');
		return;	
	  }
      resolved = true;
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      mutationObserver?.disconnect();
      console.log('ADH finish X '+(height ?? 0));
      resolve(height ?? 0);
    }

    function observe(el) { //watch height changes
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        const height = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.height);

        if (height !== lastHeight) {
	      console.log('ADH height changed from '+lastHeight+' to '+height);
          lastHeight = height;
          clearTimeout(stableTimer);
          
          //if no changes in height happened for stableForMs ms (1sec now)
          //we consider it the 'final' height and finish
          //until then we constanly "reset" the stableForMs "countdown"
          stableTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(height), stableForMs);
        }
      });

      resizeObserver.observe(el);
    }

    function tryFindTarget() {//get the dfp div containig ad iframe
      const directTag = document.getElementById("directTag");
      if (!directTag) {
	    console.log('ADH no directTag div - should never happen');
		return false;
	  }

      const firstDiv = directTag.querySelector(":scope > div");
      if (!firstDiv) {
		console.log('ADH no inner div yet within the directTag ');	
		return false;
	  }

      observe(firstDiv);
      return true;
    }

     //try to find the dfp div/iframe synchonously
    if (tryFindTarget()) {
        console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe synchonously ');	
		return;
	}

    //try to find the dfp div/iframe on each DOM mutation
    mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (tryFindTarget()) {
	    console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe on DOM mutation ');	
        mutationObserver.disconnect();
      }
    });

    mutationObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });

    // Safety timeout
    setTimeout(() => finish(lastHeight), timeoutMs);
  });
}



function initAdInfo() {

function collectA360PerformanceMetrics(prefix = "wv_") {
	var result = {};
	let perf = getPerfDimenstions();
	let bytes = getBandwidthDimensions();

	let summary = { ...perf, ...bytes };

	for (let prop in summary) {
		if (summary.hasOwnProperty(prop)) {
			result[prefix + prop] = summary[prop];
		}
	}
	return result;
}

function getPerfDimenstions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'500-1000': [], '1000-2000': [], '2000-3000': [],
			'3000-4000': [], '4000+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const d = r.duration;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (d >= 500 && d < 1000) buckets['500-1000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 2000) buckets['1000-2000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 3000) buckets['2000-3000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 4000) buckets['3000-4000'].push(domain);
			else buckets['4000+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			performance_1s: uniq(buckets['500-1000']),
			performance_2s: uniq(buckets['1000-2000']),
			performance_3s: uniq(buckets['2000-3000']),
			performance_4s: uniq(buckets['3000-4000']),
			performance_5s: uniq(buckets['4000+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

function getBandwidthDimensions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'50-100KB': [], '100-200KB': [], '200-300KB': [],
			'300-400KB': [], '400KB+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const sizeKB = (r.transferSize || 0) / 1024;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (sizeKB < 100) buckets['50-100KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 200) buckets['100-200KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 300) buckets['200-300KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 400) buckets['300-400KB'].push(domain);
			else buckets['400KB+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			bandwidth_100k: uniq(buckets['50-100KB']),
			bandwidth_200k: uniq(buckets['100-200KB']),
			bandwidth_300k: uniq(buckets['200-300KB']),
			bandwidth_400k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
			bandwidth_500k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

				<form class="login-form" method=post>
					<label for="emailInputForgot">Enter your email to receive activation code.</label>
					<input type="email" class="form-control js-validate-email" id="emailInputForgot" placeholder="Enter Email" pattern=".*" required aria-label="Enter your email to receive activation code." aria-describedby="email-error_forgot-form">
					<span class="error-message error-message__email" id="email-error_forgot-form" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

					<i class="view-password-button" tabindex="0" aria-live="assertive" role="button" name="Show or hide password" aria-pressed="false" onclick="inline.utility.showPassword( 'reset' )"></i>
					<span class="error-message error-message__password" id="pass-error_login-forgot" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

					</ul>
				</div>

			</form>

function collectBrowserDebugInfo() {

  function getBrowserInfo() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;

      name = "Chrome";

      name = "Safari";

    } else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Edge";
      version = ua.match(/Edg\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    }

    return { name, version };
  }




  // --- Extract isCommerce from dataLayer ---
  function getIsCommerce() {
    try {
      if (!Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) return "off";

      for (const item of window.dataLayer) {

          return item.isCommerce;
        }
      }

      return "off";
    } catch (e) {
      return "off";
    }
  }

  const browser = getBrowserInfo();

function collectAdSize(params) {

function waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  stableForMs = 1000,//how long the height must stay unchanged to be considered “final”
  timeoutMs = 5000 //hard stop to avoid hanging forever
} = {}) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    let lastHeight = null; //remembers last measured height
    let stableTimer = null; //countdown until we consider height “final”
    let resolved = false; //prevents resolving Promise twice
    let resizeObserver = null; //watches height changes
    let mutationObserver = null; //watches DOM for element appearance

    //resolve safely 
    //If height is null, we return 0.
    function finish(height) { 
      if (resolved) {
	    console.log('ADH finish 0');
		return;	
	  }
      resolved = true;
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      mutationObserver?.disconnect();
      console.log('ADH finish X '+(height ?? 0));
      resolve(height ?? 0);
    }

    function observe(el) { //watch height changes
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        const height = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.height);

        if (height !== lastHeight) {
	      console.log('ADH height changed from '+lastHeight+' to '+height);
          lastHeight = height;
          clearTimeout(stableTimer);
          
          //if no changes in height happened for stableForMs ms (1sec now)
          //we consider it the 'final' height and finish
          //until then we constanly "reset" the stableForMs "countdown"
          stableTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(height), stableForMs);
        }
      });

      resizeObserver.observe(el);
    }

    function tryFindTarget() {//get the dfp div containig ad iframe
      const directTag = document.getElementById("directTag");
      if (!directTag) {
	    console.log('ADH no directTag div - should never happen');
		return false;
	  }

      const firstDiv = directTag.querySelector(":scope > div");
      if (!firstDiv) {
		console.log('ADH no inner div yet within the directTag ');	
		return false;
	  }

      observe(firstDiv);
      return true;
    }

     //try to find the dfp div/iframe synchonously
    if (tryFindTarget()) {
        console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe synchonously ');	
		return;
	}

    //try to find the dfp div/iframe on each DOM mutation
    mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (tryFindTarget()) {
	    console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe on DOM mutation ');	
        mutationObserver.disconnect();
      }
    });

    mutationObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });

    // Safety timeout
    setTimeout(() => finish(lastHeight), timeoutMs);
  });
}



function initAdInfo() {
	
	if (Math.random() > 0.10 && !window.location.href.includes('forceAdHeightTrack')) {
		console.log("ADH","bail 0");

	}
						
	
	window.googletag = window.googletag || {};
	googletag.cmd = googletag.cmd || [];

	window.adInfo = window.adInfo || {};

	console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] adding to googletag.cmd queue');

	googletag.cmd.push(() => {
		const pubads = googletag.pubads?.();
		if (!pubads) {
			console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] googletag.pubads not available');
			return;
		}

		console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] adding "slotRenderEnded" listener');

		pubads.addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => {

			const slot = event.slot;
			
			//console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] slot id rendered',slot.getSlotId(),slot.getSlotElementId());
			
			const slotId = slot?.getSlotElementId();
			if (!slotId) {
				console.log("ADH","bail 1",slot);
				return;
			}
	
			if (slotId !== 'directTag') return; 

			if (window.a360_ad_size_recorded && window.a360_ad_size_recorded[slotId]) {
				console.log('ADH','A2 slot '+slotId+' already logged, skipping');
				return;
			}

			// Non-blocking logging
			setTimeout(() => {

				const slotEl = document.getElementById(slotId);
				if (!slotEl) {
					console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] no slot element ', slotId);
					return;
				}

				const iframe = slotEl.querySelector('iframe');
				if (!iframe) {
					console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] no frame ', slotId);
					return;
				}

				console.log("ADH", 'before requestAnimationFrame ', slotId);
				requestAnimationFrame(() => {
					console.log("ADH", 'after requestAnimationFrame ', slotId, slot);
					waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  					   stableForMs: 800,
 					   timeoutMs: 6000
					}).then(height => {
   							 console.log('ADH final height', height);

									'ADH Actual rendered size',

								);

	});
}

		function setupSTNApi(getApi) {
			const stnPlayer = document.querySelector('div[data-stn-player]');
			const stnApi = getApi(stnPlayer);

			if (!stnApi) {
				console.error("Failed to retrieve STN API. Please reach out to your STN Video contact for troubleshooting.");
				return;
			}

			function mutationCallback(mutationsList) {
				for (const mutation of mutationsList) {
					if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
						const hasAlertBar = document.body.classList.contains('has-alert-bar');
						stnApi.floatApi.verticalTranslate = hasAlertBar ? 50 : 0;
					}
				}
			}

			const observerConfig = {
				attributes: true,
				attributeFilter: ['class'],
				subtree: false,
			};

			const observer = new MutationObserver(mutationCallback);

			observer.observe(document.body, observerConfig);

			mutationCallback([ { type: 'attributes', attributeName: 'class' } ]);
		}

			function sendEvent(loafData) {

					inp_processing_time: inpBreakdown.inp_processing_time,
					inp_presentation_delay: inpBreakdown.inp_presentation_delay,
					loaf_blocking: loafData.loaf_blocking,

					loaf_script_count: loafData.loaf_script_count,

					loaf_worst_duration: loafData.loaf_worst_duration,
					loaf_worst_function: loafData.loaf_worst_function,
					loaf_top5_scripts: loafData.loaf_top5_scripts,
					loaf_domains: loafData.loaf_domains,
					loaf_preceding_blocking: loafData.loaf_preceding_blocking,

					loaf_preceding_domains: loafData.loaf_preceding_domains,

					ua: userAgent
				};
				gtm_event = Object.assign({}, gtm_event, perfMetrics);
				gtm_event.pageLoadId=S3Helper.pageLoadId,
			    gtm_event.url=window.location.href;

				window.S3Helper.pushToS3(gtm_event,true);//need to be synchonous, otherwise we'll leave the browser'
			}

			// --- NEW APPROACH: register as pending, let LoAF observer match it ---
			// Store the INP and let the LoAF observer callback (above) find overlapping frames
			var timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
				// Timeout: LoAF didn't arrive in time (non-Chrome, short INP, or no long frame)
				// Try one last buffer scan then send with whatever we have
				_pendingINP = null;
				var intStart = e.startTime;
				var intEnd = intStart + e.duration;
				var INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK = 500;
				var lookbackStart = intStart - INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK;
				var matched = [];
				var preceding = [];
				for (var b = 0; b < _loafBuffer.length; b++) {
					var loaf = _loafBuffer[b];
					var loafEnd = loaf.startTime + loaf.duration;
					if (loaf.startTime < intEnd && loafEnd > intStart) {
						matched.push(loaf);
					} else if (loafEnd > lookbackStart && loafEnd <= intStart && loaf.blockingDuration > 0) {
						preceding.push(loaf);
					}
				}
				var loafData = (matched.length || preceding.length) ? buildLoafResult(matched, e, preceding) : {};

				if (force_inp_debug) {
					console.warn("WV INP", "LoAF timeout fallback. Buffer size:", _loafBuffer.length, "Matched:", matched.length, "Preceding:", preceding.length);
					if (_loafBuffer.length) {
						var first = _loafBuffer[0];
						var last = _loafBuffer[_loafBuffer.length - 1];
						console.warn("WV INP", "Buffer range:", first.startTime, "to", (last.startTime + last.duration), "| INP window:", intStart, "to", intEnd);
					}
					console.warn("WV INP", "LoAF data (timeout):", loafData);
				}

				sendEvent(loafData || {});
			}, _PENDING_TIMEOUT);

			_pendingINP = {
				entry: { startTime: e.startTime, duration: e.duration, interactionId: e.interactionId },
				sendEvent: sendEvent,
				timeoutId: timeoutId,
				force_inp_debug: force_inp_debug
			};

			if (force_inp_debug) {
				console.warn("WV INP", "Registered pending INP. Waiting for LoAF observer to deliver matching frame...");
				console.warn("WV INP", "INP window:", e.startTime, "to", (e.startTime + e.duration), "(duration:", e.duration + "ms)");
				console.warn("WV INP", "Current LoAF buffer size:", _loafBuffer.length);
				console.warn("WV INP", "INP breakdown:", inpBreakdown);
			}
		
	};
	
	
	// --- LoAF Observer ---
	// When a new LoAF entry arrives, check if there's a pending INP that overlaps
	if ('PerformanceObserver' in window && 'PerformanceLongAnimationFrameTiming' in window) {
		try {
			new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
				var entries = list.getEntries();
				for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
					_loafBuffer.push(entries[i]);
					if (_loafBuffer.length > _LOAF_MAX) _loafBuffer.shift();
				}

				// Check if we have a pending INP that can now be matched
				if (_pendingINP) {
					var intStart = _pendingINP.entry.startTime;
					var intEnd = intStart + _pendingINP.entry.duration;
					// Expand window backwards to catch frames that caused input_delay
					// A LoAF frame that ended just before intStart blocked the main thread
					var INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK = 500; // ms before interaction start
					var lookbackStart = intStart - INPUT_DELAY_LOOKBACK;
					var matched = [];
					var preceding = []; // frames that ended before interaction but caused input delay
					for (var b = 0; b < _loafBuffer.length; b++) {
						var loaf = _loafBuffer[b];
						var loafEnd = loaf.startTime + loaf.duration;
						if (loaf.startTime < intEnd && loafEnd > intStart) {
							// Overlaps with interaction
							matched.push(loaf);
						} else if (loafEnd > lookbackStart && loafEnd <= intStart && loaf.blockingDuration > 0) {
							// Ended just before interaction — likely caused input delay
							preceding.push(loaf);
						}
					}
					if (matched.length > 0 || preceding.length > 0) {
						var loafData = buildLoafResult(matched, _pendingINP.entry, preceding);
						if (loafData) {
							var pending = _pendingINP;
							_pendingINP = null;
							clearTimeout(pending.timeoutId);
							if (pending.force_inp_debug) {
								console.warn("WV INP", "LoAF matched via observer callback!", loafData);
								console.warn("WV INP", "Overlapping frames:", matched.length, "| Preceding frames (caused input delay):", preceding.length);
								console.warn("WV INP", "INP window:", intStart, "to", intEnd);
								for (var m = 0; m < matched.length; m++) {
									console.warn("WV INP", "  Overlap", m + ":", "start=" + matched[m].startTime, "end=" + (matched[m].startTime + matched[m].duration), "blocking=" + matched[m].blockingDuration + "ms", "scripts=" + (matched[m].scripts ? matched[m].scripts.length : 0));
								}
								for (var p = 0; p < preceding.length; p++) {
									console.warn("WV INP", "  Preceding", p + ":", "start=" + preceding[p].startTime, "end=" + (preceding[p].startTime + preceding[p].duration), "blocking=" + preceding[p].blockingDuration + "ms", "scripts=" + (preceding[p].scripts ? preceding[p].scripts.length : 0));
								}
							}
							pending.sendEvent(loafData);
						}
					}

	}

	function buildLoafResult(loafs, entry, precedingLoafs) {
		var scripts = [];
		var totalBlocking = 0;
		var precedingScripts = [];
		var precedingBlocking = 0;

		// Process overlapping LoAF frames (during interaction)
		for (var i = 0; i < loafs.length; i++) {
			var loaf = loafs[i];
			totalBlocking += loaf.blockingDuration || 0;
			if (loaf.scripts) {
				for (var s = 0; s < loaf.scripts.length; s++) {
					var sc = loaf.scripts[s];
					scripts.push({
						invoker: (sc.invoker || '').substring(0, 200),
						sourceURL: (sc.sourceURL || '').substring(0, 300),
						duration: Math.round(sc.duration || 0),
						sourceFunctionName: (sc.sourceFunctionName || '').substring(0, 100),
						invokerType: sc.invokerType || 'unknown'
					});
				}
			}
		}

		// Process preceding LoAF frames (caused input delay)
		if (precedingLoafs && precedingLoafs.length) {
			for (var j = 0; j < precedingLoafs.length; j++) {
				var ploaf = precedingLoafs[j];
				precedingBlocking += ploaf.blockingDuration || 0;
				if (ploaf.scripts) {
					for (var ps = 0; ps < ploaf.scripts.length; ps++) {
						var psc = ploaf.scripts[ps];
						precedingScripts.push({
							invoker: (psc.invoker || '').substring(0, 200),
							sourceURL: (psc.sourceURL || '').substring(0, 300),
							duration: Math.round(psc.duration || 0),
							sourceFunctionName: (psc.sourceFunctionName || '').substring(0, 100),
							invokerType: psc.invokerType || 'unknown'
						});
					}
				}
			}
		}

		var allScripts = scripts.concat(precedingScripts);
		if (!allScripts.length && !loafs.length && !(precedingLoafs && precedingLoafs.length)) return null;

		// All scripts sorted by duration for top5 and domains
		allScripts.sort(function (a, b) { return b.duration - a.duration; });
		var top5 = allScripts.slice(0, 5);

		var domains = {};
		for (var t = 0; t < allScripts.length; t++) {
			if (allScripts[t].sourceURL) {
				try {
					var d = new URL(allScripts[t].sourceURL).hostname;
					domains[d] = (domains[d] || 0) + allScripts[t].duration;
				} catch (e) { }
			}
		}

		// Preceding scripts sorted separately for the "who caused input delay" field
		precedingScripts.sort(function (a, b) { return b.duration - a.duration; });
		var precedingDomains = {};
		for (var pd = 0; pd < precedingScripts.length; pd++) {
			if (precedingScripts[pd].sourceURL) {
				try {
					var dom = new URL(precedingScripts[pd].sourceURL).hostname;
					precedingDomains[dom] = (precedingDomains[dom] || 0) + precedingScripts[pd].duration;
				} catch (e) { }
			}
		}

		return {
			loaf_blocking: Math.round(totalBlocking),
			loaf_frame_count: loafs.length,
			loaf_script_count: scripts.length,
			loaf_worst_script: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].sourceURL : null,
			loaf_worst_invoker: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].invoker : null,
			loaf_worst_duration: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].duration : 0,
			loaf_worst_function: allScripts.length ? allScripts[0].sourceFunctionName : null,
			loaf_top5_scripts: JSON.stringify(top5),
			loaf_domains: JSON.stringify(domains),
			// NEW: who was blocking main thread BEFORE the click (caused input_delay)
			loaf_preceding_blocking: Math.round(precedingBlocking),
			loaf_preceding_frame_count: precedingLoafs ? precedingLoafs.length : 0,
			loaf_preceding_domains: JSON.stringify(precedingDomains),
			loaf_preceding_worst_script: precedingScripts.length ? precedingScripts[0].sourceURL : null,
			loaf_preceding_worst_duration: precedingScripts.length ? precedingScripts[0].duration : 0

	}

	function getINPBreakdown(entry) {
		if (!entry || !entry.processingStart) return null;
		var inputDelay = Math.round(entry.processingStart - entry.startTime);
		var processingTime = Math.round(entry.processingEnd - entry.processingStart);
		var presentation = Math.round((entry.startTime + entry.duration) - entry.processingEnd);
		return {
			inp_input_delay: inputDelay,
			inp_processing_time: processingTime,
			inp_presentation_delay: presentation
		};
	}


	function getLongestDurationEntry(entries) {
		if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) {
			return null;
		}

		return entries.reduce((maxEntry, currentEntry) => {
			return currentEntry.duration > maxEntry.duration ? currentEntry : maxEntry;
		});
	}

	function getNestedElementDescriptors(element) {
		const parts = [];
		const MAX_DEPTH = 10;

		function getNodeDescriptor(node) {
			const tag = (node.tagName || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
			const idPart = node.id && String(node.id).trim() ? '#' + node.id : '';
			let classPart = '';
			if (node.classList && node.classList.length) {
				classPart = '.' + [...node.classList].join('.');
			} else if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string') {
				const cn = node.className.trim();
				if (cn) classPart = '.' + cn.split(/\s+/).join('.');
			}
			return tag + idPart + classPart;
		}

		function traverse(node, depth) {
			if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) return;

			parts.push(getNodeDescriptor(node));

			if (node.children && typeof node.children[Symbol.iterator] === 'function') {
				for (const child of node.children) {
					traverse(child, depth + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		traverse(element, 0);

		return parts.join('|');
	}

	// Get the inline style of the element
	function getInlineStyleSnippet(el) {
		const raw = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('style');
		if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return '';
		const snippet = raw.trim().slice(0, 300);
		return ' [style="' + snippet + (raw.length > 300 ? '...' : '') + '"]';
	}

	// Get the attributes of the element
	function getAttributesSnippet(el) {
		if (!el.attributes || !el.attributes.length) return '';
		const skip = { id: 1, class: 1, style: 1 };
		const parts = [];
		const maxValueLen = 80;
		const maxTotalLen = 200;
		for (let i = 0; i < el.attributes.length; i++) {
			const a = el.attributes[i];
			if (skip[a.name]) continue;
			const val = (a.value || '').trim().slice(0, maxValueLen) + (a.value && a.value.length > maxValueLen ? '...' : '');
			parts.push('[' + a.name + '="' + val + '"]');
		}
		const joined = parts.join('');
		return joined.length > maxTotalLen ? joined.slice(0, maxTotalLen) + '...' : joined;
	}

	// Get the parent chain of the element
	function getNodeShortDesc(node) {
		const tag = (node.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
		let part = tag;
		if (node.id) part += '#' + node.id;
		if (node.classList && node.classList.length) {
			part += '.' + [...node.classList].join('.');
		} else if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string') {
			const cn = node.className.trim();
			if (cn) part += '.' + cn.split(/\s+/).join('.');
		}
		return part;
	}

	function getParentSnippet(el) {
		if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1) return '';
		const parts = [];
		let node = el.parentElement;
		while (node && node !== document.body) {
			parts.push(getNodeShortDesc(node));
			node = node.parentElement;
		}
		if (document.body) {
			parts.push(getNodeShortDesc(document.body));
		}
		if (parts.length === 0) return '';
		return ' ^ ' + parts.join('|');
	}

	// We really suspect lots of INPs are coming from the begenuin widget, thus we added extra check just for it
	function isInsideBegenuinWidget(element) {
		if (!element || element.nodeType !== 1) return false;
		let node = element;
		while (node && node !== document.body) {
			if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('begenuin-widget')) return true;
			if (node.className && typeof node.className === 'string' && node.className.indexOf('begenuin-widget') !== -1) return true;
			node = node.parentElement;
		}
		return false;
	}

	function buildTargetDescriptor(target, eventName) {
		if (!target || target.nodeType !== 1) return null;
		const tag = (target.tagName || 'n/a').toLowerCase();
		let elementDesc = eventName + ":" + tag;
		if (target.id) elementDesc += "#" + target.id;
		if (target.classList && target.classList.length) {
			elementDesc += "." + [...target.classList].join('.');
		} else if (target.className && typeof target.className === 'string' && target.className.trim()) {
			elementDesc += "." + target.className.trim().split(/\s+/).join('.');
		}
		elementDesc += getInlineStyleSnippet(target);
		elementDesc += getAttributesSnippet(target);
		elementDesc += getParentSnippet(target);
		if (target.innerText) {
			elementDesc += ': "' + target.innerText.trim() + '"';
		}
		const targetChildrenIDs = getNestedElementDescriptors(target);
		return { elementDesc: elementDesc, targetChildrenIDs: targetChildrenIDs };
	}



	function captureInpTarget(ev) {
		if (!ev.target || ev.target.nodeType !== 1) return;
		const desc = buildTargetDescriptor(ev.target, ev.type);
		if (desc) {
			window._lastInpTargetCapture = {
				elementDesc: desc.elementDesc,
				targetChildrenIDs: desc.targetChildrenIDs,
				isBegenuin: isInsideBegenuinWidget(ev.target),
				time: Date.now()
			};
		}
	}

	document.addEventListener('pointerdown', captureInpTarget, true);
	document.addEventListener('click', captureInpTarget, true);
