window.__S3_QUEUE__ = [];
window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__ = false;

const S3_API_URL = "https://yyd10wh581.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/";
const MAX_QUEUE_SIZE = 100;

const FLUSH_INTERVAL = 5000;   // check every 5s
const MIN_BATCH_SIZE = 5;      // don't send tiny batches
const MAX_WAIT = 10000;        // force flush after 10s

let __lastFlushTime = Date.now();

function flushS3Queue() {
	const queue = window.__S3_QUEUE__;
	if (!queue || queue.length === 0) return;

	const payload = queue.splice(0, queue.length);
	const body = JSON.stringify(payload);

	try {
		fetch(S3_API_URL, {
			method: "POST",
			headers: {
				"Content-Type": "application/json",
				"Accept": "application/json"
			},
			body,
			keepalive: true
		})
			.then(r => r.text())
			.then(data => console.log("WV", "Batch push:", data))
			.catch(err => console.error("WV", "Batch push error:", err));

	} catch (e) {
		console.error("WV", "flush error:", e);
	}
}

function startS3Poller() {
	if (window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__) return;
	window.__S3_POLLER_STARTED__ = true;

	setTimeout(() => {
		setInterval(() => {
			const now = Date.now();
			const queueSize = window.__S3_QUEUE__.length;

			if (
				queueSize >= MIN_BATCH_SIZE ||
				(queueSize > 0 && now - __lastFlushTime > MAX_WAIT)
			) {
				flushS3Queue();
				__lastFlushTime = now;
			}
		}, FLUSH_INTERVAL);
	}, 1000);
}

startS3Poller();


// final flush (IMPORTANT - now using keepalive fetch)
window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => flushS3Queue());
window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => flushS3Queue());

function collectA360PerformanceMetrics(prefix = "wv_") {
	var result = {};
	let perf = getPerfDimenstions();
	let bytes = getBandwidthDimensions();

	let summary = { ...perf, ...bytes };

	for (let prop in summary) {
		if (summary.hasOwnProperty(prop)) {
			result[prefix + prop] = summary[prop];
		}
	}
	return result;
}

function getPerfDimenstions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');

function collectBrowserDebugInfo() {

	function isMobile() {
      return /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  }

  // --- Browser name + version ---
  function getBrowserInfo() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;

    let name = "Unknown";
    let version = "Unknown";

    if (/Chrome/.test(ua) && !/Edge/.test(ua) && !/OPR/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Chrome";
      version = ua.match(/Chrome\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Firefox/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Firefox";
      version = ua.match(/Firefox\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Safari/.test(ua) && !/Chrome/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Safari";
      version = ua.match(/Version\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Edge";
      version = ua.match(/Edg\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    }

    return { name, version };
  }




  // --- Extract isCommerce from dataLayer ---
  function getIsCommerce() {
    try {
      if (!Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) return "off";

      for (const item of window.dataLayer) {
        if (typeof item === "object" && item.isCommerce !== undefined) {
          return item.isCommerce;
        }
      }

      return "off";
    } catch (e) {
      return "off";
    }
  }

  const browser = getBrowserInfo();

  return {
    browser: browser.name,
    browserVersion: browser.version,
    platformOS: navigator.platform || "unknown",
    pageURL: location.href,
    pageReferrer: document.referrer || null,
    inIframe: window.self !== window.top,
    isCommerce: getIsCommerce(),
  	ts: Date.now(),
		isMobile:isMobile()
  };
}

	}

function startS3Poller() {

function collectA360PerformanceMetrics(prefix = "wv_") {
	var result = {};
	let perf = getPerfDimenstions();
	let bytes = getBandwidthDimensions();

	let summary = { ...perf, ...bytes };

	for (let prop in summary) {
		if (summary.hasOwnProperty(prop)) {
			result[prefix + prop] = summary[prop];
		}
	}
	return result;
}

function getPerfDimenstions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'500-1000': [], '1000-2000': [], '2000-3000': [],
			'3000-4000': [], '4000+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const d = r.duration;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (d >= 500 && d < 1000) buckets['500-1000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 2000) buckets['1000-2000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 3000) buckets['2000-3000'].push(domain);
			else if (d < 4000) buckets['3000-4000'].push(domain);
			else buckets['4000+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			performance_1s: uniq(buckets['500-1000']),
			performance_2s: uniq(buckets['1000-2000']),
			performance_3s: uniq(buckets['2000-3000']),
			performance_4s: uniq(buckets['3000-4000']),
			performance_5s: uniq(buckets['4000+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

function getBandwidthDimensions() {
	try {
		const resources = performance.getEntriesByType("resource") || [];

		function getApexDomain(url) {
			try {
				const hostname = new URL(url).hostname;
				const parts = hostname.split('.');
				return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : hostname;
			} catch {
				return 'invalid';
			}
		}

		const buckets = {
			'50-100KB': [], '100-200KB': [], '200-300KB': [],
			'300-400KB': [], '400KB+': []
		};

		const scriptResources = resources.filter(r => r.initiatorType === 'script');

		for (const r of scriptResources) {
			const sizeKB = (r.transferSize || 0) / 1024;
			const domain = getApexDomain(r.name);

			if (sizeKB < 100) buckets['50-100KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 200) buckets['100-200KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 300) buckets['200-300KB'].push(domain);
			else if (sizeKB < 400) buckets['300-400KB'].push(domain);
			else buckets['400KB+'].push(domain);
		}

		const uniq = arr => [...new Set(arr)].sort().join('|');

		return {
			bandwidth_100k: uniq(buckets['50-100KB']),
			bandwidth_200k: uniq(buckets['100-200KB']),
			bandwidth_300k: uniq(buckets['200-300KB']),
			bandwidth_400k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
			bandwidth_500k: uniq(buckets['400KB+']),
		};

	} catch {
		return {};
	}
}

			<div class="login-form__wrapper">
				<form class="login-form" method=post>
					<label for="emailInputForgot">Enter your email to receive activation code.</label>
					<input type="email" class="form-control js-validate-email" id="emailInputForgot" placeholder="Enter Email" pattern=".*" required aria-label="Enter your email to receive activation code." aria-describedby="email-error_forgot-form">
					<span class="error-message error-message__email" id="email-error_forgot-form" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

					</div>
				</form>
			</div>

			<div class="login-body__title">Reset your password</div>

						<input type="number" min="0" max="9" maxlength="1" class="recovery-code__input" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Validation Code">

					<span class="error-message error-message__password" id="pass-error_login-forgot" aria-live="assertive" role="alert"></span>

<script type="text/html" id="tmpl-posts">

	<article class="celebrity-news-article article-box">
		<a
			class="celebrity-news-article-link"
			href="{{ data.link }}"
		>

			<div class="article-box-image">

					<figure class="celebrity-image--rect img-fit" itemprop="image" itemscope="" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject">
						<div class="img-fit__image-contain ratio-based-placeholder" style="{{ data.image.landscape.placeholder_styles }}">
							<# if ( data.image && data.image.landscape.fallback ) { #>
								<# if ( 'status' === data.format ) { #>
									<div class="us-vip-badge">
			<img src="/wp-content/themes/us-weekly/assets/img/svg-icons/logo-us-vip.svg" width="50" alt="US VIP logo" class="icon-us-vip">
		</div>								<# } #>
								<img
									src="{{ data.image.landscape.fallback }}"
									srcset="{{ data.image.landscape.srcset }}"
									sizes="100vw"
									width="{{ data.image.landscape.width }}"
									height="{{ data.image.landscape.height }}"
									alt="{{ data.title.rendered }}"
									loading="lazy">
							<# } #>
						</div>
					</figure>

			</div>

			<div class="article-box-content">
				<div class="article-box-content-inner">
					<# if ( data.post_live_updates ) { #>
					<span class="live-updates"><span class="live-updates__badge">Live</span></span>
					<# } #>
					<span class="article-box-tag">{{ data.category_name }}</span>
					<h3 class="article-box-title">{{ data.title.rendered }}</h3>
				</div>
			</div>
		</a>
	</article>

</script>

<script>



function collectBrowserDebugInfo() {

	function isMobile() {
      return /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  }

  // --- Browser name + version ---
  function getBrowserInfo() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;

    let name = "Unknown";
    let version = "Unknown";

    if (/Chrome/.test(ua) && !/Edge/.test(ua) && !/OPR/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Chrome";
      version = ua.match(/Chrome\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Firefox/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Firefox";
      version = ua.match(/Firefox\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Safari/.test(ua) && !/Chrome/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Safari";
      version = ua.match(/Version\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    } else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) {
      name = "Edge";
      version = ua.match(/Edg\/([0-9.]+)/)?.[1];
    }

    return { name, version };
  }




  // --- Extract isCommerce from dataLayer ---
  function getIsCommerce() {
    try {
      if (!Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) return "off";

      for (const item of window.dataLayer) {
        if (typeof item === "object" && item.isCommerce !== undefined) {
          return item.isCommerce;
        }
      }

      return "off";
    } catch (e) {
      return "off";
    }
  }

  const browser = getBrowserInfo();

  return {
    browser: browser.name,
    browserVersion: browser.version,
    platformOS: navigator.platform || "unknown",
    pageURL: location.href,
    pageReferrer: document.referrer || null,
    inIframe: window.self !== window.top,
    isCommerce: getIsCommerce(),
  	ts: Date.now(),
		isMobile:isMobile()
  };
}

function collectAdSize(params) {
	
	if (window.a360_ad_size_recorded && window.a360_ad_size_recorded[params.slotId]) {

		var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();

		xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {

function waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  stableForMs = 1000,//how long the height must stay unchanged to be considered “final”
  timeoutMs = 5000 //hard stop to avoid hanging forever
} = {}) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    let lastHeight = null; //remembers last measured height
    let stableTimer = null; //countdown until we consider height “final”
    let resolved = false; //prevents resolving Promise twice
    let resizeObserver = null; //watches height changes
    let mutationObserver = null; //watches DOM for element appearance

    //resolve safely 
    //If height is null, we return 0.
    function finish(height) { 
      if (resolved) {
	    console.log('ADH finish 0');
		return;	
	  }
      resolved = true;
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      mutationObserver?.disconnect();
      console.log('ADH finish X '+(height ?? 0));
      resolve(height ?? 0);
    }

    function observe(el) { //watch height changes
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
        const height = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.height);

        if (height !== lastHeight) {
	      console.log('ADH height changed from '+lastHeight+' to '+height);
          lastHeight = height;
          clearTimeout(stableTimer);
          
          //if no changes in height happened for stableForMs ms (1sec now)
          //we consider it the 'final' height and finish
          //until then we constanly "reset" the stableForMs "countdown"
          stableTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(height), stableForMs);
        }
      });

      resizeObserver.observe(el);
    }

    function tryFindTarget() {//get the dfp div containig ad iframe
      const directTag = document.getElementById("directTag");
      if (!directTag) {
	    console.log('ADH no directTag div - should never happen');
		return false;
	  }

      const firstDiv = directTag.querySelector(":scope > div");
      if (!firstDiv) {
		console.log('ADH no inner div yet within the directTag ');	
		return false;
	  }

      observe(firstDiv);
      return true;
    }

     //try to find the dfp div/iframe synchonously
    if (tryFindTarget()) {
        console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe synchonously ');	
		return;
	}

    //try to find the dfp div/iframe on each DOM mutation
    mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (tryFindTarget()) {
	    console.log('ADH found dfp div/iframe on DOM mutation ');	
        mutationObserver.disconnect();
      }
    });

    mutationObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });

    // Safety timeout
    setTimeout(() => finish(lastHeight), timeoutMs);
  });
}



function initAdInfo() {

	googletag.cmd.push(() => {

		console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] adding "slotRenderEnded" listener');

		pubads.addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => {

			const slot = event.slot;
			
			//console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] slot id rendered',slot.getSlotId(),slot.getSlotElementId());
			
			const slotId = slot?.getSlotElementId();
			if (!slotId) {

			}
	
			if (slotId !== 'directTag') return;

			// Non-blocking logging
			setTimeout(() => {

				const slotEl = document.getElementById(slotId);
				if (!slotEl) {
					console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] no slot element ', slotId);
					return;
				}

				const iframe = slotEl.querySelector('iframe');
				if (!iframe) {
					console.log("ADH", '[adInfo] no frame ', slotId);

				}

				console.log("ADH", 'before requestAnimationFrame ', slotId);
				requestAnimationFrame(() => {
					console.log("ADH", 'after requestAnimationFrame ', slotId, slot);
					waitForFinalHeightFromDirectTag({
  					   stableForMs: 800,
 					   timeoutMs: 6000
					}).then(height => {
   							 console.log('ADH final height', height);

  						 });		
				});

			}, 0);
		});
	});
}
